The existing ro mounts should remain non-recursive, for compatibility sake. The "rro" mount type has been supported by runc >= 1.1, on kernel >= 5.12. Support recursive mount attrs ("rro", "rnosuid", "rnodev", ...) opencontainers/runc#3272 The "rro" mount type has to be used in conjunction with rprivate propagation, in order to avoid accidentally having writable submounts.
